commands.name: m126_m124_outcome_critical_wrong_history_check

decision_rule: Before another objective or PPO continuation, determine whether the zero-relvel belief proof should use the current hidden-envelope targets, outcome-critical wrong-history gates, or a redesigned target/intervention surface.
failure_criteria: another PPO or continuation starts before the M125 hidden-probe failure is diagnosed
probe targets are accepted despite fresh-seed instability
the next objective optimizes only fixed snippets without a reliable belief/outcome gate
no-action and wrong-history neutrality are ignored
hypothesis: M125 shows behavior retention is stable but hidden-envelope proof is probe-seed fragile. The next highest-leverage step is to audit the belief proof surface rather than tune PPO.
success_criteria: identify whether hidden-envelope target distributions are stable across probe seeds
compare M105 and M124 against current-response/reset baselines on the same zero-relvel profile
decide whether yaw/lateral/braking targets remain valid gates
define the next admitted proof surface before another objective or PPO run
